aids.description_en: Social insurance retirement pension from Vietnam Social Security (VSS/BHXH). Benefit = 45% of average salary after 20 years of contributions, +2% per additional year (max 75%). Average monthly pension approximately VND 3,000,000 (2025). Retirement age: men 62, women 60 (rising to 62 by 2035). Source: baohiemxahoi.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Bao hiem xa hoi Viet Nam (BHXH — VSS)

aids.nom: Tro cap that nghiep — Allocation chomage (BHTN)
aids.description_en: Unemployment insurance benefit of 60% of average monthly salary from the previous 6 months of employment. Duration: 3 months (12-35 months contributed), 6 months (36-71 months), 9 months (72-143 months), 12 months (144+ months). Paid by unemployment insurance fund (BHTN). Source: molisa.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Trung tam Dich vu Viec lam / BHXH

aids.nom: Tro cap nguoi khuyet tat — Allocation handicap
aids.description_en: Monthly social assistance for persons with disabilities: VND 405,000/month for moderate disability; VND 540,000/month for severe disability; VND 810,000/month for extremely severe disability. Additional household support available. Source: molisa.gov.vn (Decree 20/2021/ND-CP).
aids.organisme: So Lao dong - Thuong binh va Xa hoi (SOLĐTBXH)

aids.nom: Tro cap bao tro xa hoi — Allocation personnes agees
aids.description_en: Social protection allowance for elderly: VND 360,000/month for those aged 75-79 without pension or social insurance; VND 540,000/month for those aged 80+ without pension. Paid by commune-level social affairs. Source: Decree 20/2021/ND-CP, molisa.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Uy ban nhan dan xa/phuong / So LDTBXH

aids.nom: Bao hiem y te (BHYT) — Assurance maladie
aids.description_en: Health insurance (BHYT). State subsidizes 100% of premium for poor households and near-poor households (95% of premium). Covers 80-100% of medical costs at registered facilities. Veterans and meritorious persons covered at 100%. Source: bhyt.gov.vn / baohiemxahoi.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: BHXH Viet Nam / Bo Y te

aids.nom: Chinh sach nha o xa hoi — Logement social
aids.description_en: Subsidized housing loans at 4.8% annual interest rate (2025) through the Social Policy Bank (VBSP) for purchase or construction of social housing. Maximum loan VND 500,000,000 per household. Income eligibility: no owned home or housing below standard. Source: moc.gov.vn / vbsp.org.vn.
aids.organisme: Ngan hang Chinh sach Xa hoi (VBSP) / Bo Xay dung

aids.nom: Hoc bong HSSVDT — Bourse etudiants minorites ethniques
aids.description_en: Scholarship for ethnic minority students and students from disadvantaged areas. Monthly allowance: VND 200,000-1,000,000/month depending on level and location (boarding allowance, monthly stipend). Also includes exemption/reduction of tuition fees. Source: Decree 86/2015/ND-CP, moet.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Bo Giao duc va Dao tao (MOET)

aids.nom: Tro cap thai san — Conge maternite (BHXH)
aids.description_en: Maternity benefit from social insurance (BHXH): 100% of average monthly salary for 6 months (for vaginal birth) or 6 months (C-section). For fathers: 5-14 working days paid leave at 100% salary. Funded through social insurance contributions. Source: baohiemxahoi.gov.vn (Law 58/2014/QH13).
aids.organisme: Bao hiem xa hoi Viet Nam (BHXH)

aids.nom: Chinh sach ho ngheo — Politique pauvrete multidimensionnelle
aids.description_en: Multi-dimensional poverty reduction policy package providing: free BHYT health card, fee waivers for education, housing support, clean water subsidy, preferential loans via VBSP, agricultural extension support. National poverty line 2021-2025: rural Rp 1,500,000/person/month, urban Rp 2,000,000/person/month. Source: molisa.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Bo LDTBXH / Uy ban nhan dan cac cap

aids.nom: Chuong trinh giam ngheo da chieu
aids.description_en: National multi-dimensional poverty reduction program 2021-2025 targeting 8 dimensions (income, employment, housing, water, sanitation, education, health, information). Specific support packages per dimension: vocational training grants, micro-credit at 0%, house repair grants up to VND 40,000,000. Source: molisa.gov.vn.
aids.organisme: Bo LDTBXH / ngan sach nha nuoc

aids.nom: Tro cap nguoi co cong cach mang — Meritorious persons
aids.description_en: Monthly benefit for war heroes, wounded veterans, families of fallen soldiers and revolutionary meritorious persons. Amounts vary: wounded soldiers Rp 2,000,000-4,500,000/month based on disability grade. Fully funded by state budget. Source: molisa.gov.vn (Ordinance 02/2020/UBTVQH14).
aids.organisme: Bo LDTBXH / So LDTBXH cac tinh
